fusions.name: Mark the Quarry
fusions.desc: Flicks a strand at an enemy up to 6 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Finish the Chase
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Fires a venom dart that deals 18 damage, rising 8% for each affliction on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Closing Quiet
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scent of the Faltering
fusions.desc: Against an enemy below half health, your damage rises 12%.
